title: snapshot-writer: Runtime should write RunSnapshot after every N steps
description: Feature P2-18. Master §68 (Durable Execution Architecture Contract) requires snapshot-plus-tail recovery: load latest snapshot, replay tail events. RunSnapshot writer is dead in production. hydrate_run_frame(snapshot, tail) (hydrate.rs:182-201) is the master §68 primary path. P2-15 decides whether to wire RunSnapshot; this bead assumes WIRED. Add snapshot_interval_steps: u64 to ShardConfig (default 1000, configurable). In drive_deterministic_full (engine/drive.rs:46), after every snapshot_interval_steps successful steps, call journal.put_snapshot(&RunSnapshot { ... }). In Runtime::recover (P0-5 fix), for each non-terminal run, try journal.snapshot(run, last_snapshot_seq) first; if present, use hydrate_run_frame(snapshot, tail). Otherwise, fall back. Add a benchmark: submit + 10_000 step workflow + recover measures <100ms with snapshots, vs 10s+ with events. Depends on P0-5.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL write a RunSnapshot to the journal every snapshot_interval_steps successful steps
THE SYSTEM SHALL use snapshot-plus-tail recovery when a snapshot is present, falling back to full replay only when no snapshot exists

event_driven.trigger: WHEN drive_deterministic_full completes N successful steps where N is a multiple of snapshot_interval_steps
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL call journal.put_snapshot(&RunSnapshot { slots, taint, step_states, last_seq })

event_driven.trigger: WHEN Runtime::recover is called and a snapshot exists for the run
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL call hydrate_run_frame(snapshot, tail_events_from_last_snapshot_seq) instead of full replay

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT default to 'no snapshots' silently; it must return InvalidSnapshotInterval
unwanted.because: Operators must explicitly opt in to the no-snapshot path for benchmarking

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT continue executing steps; it must abort the run with SnapshotCommitFailed
unwanted.because: Master §68.1: journal entry persisted = step happened; a failed snapshot write must roll back

preconditions: Runtime::recover has the P0-5 fix landed (depends on P0-5)
postconditions: A 1000-step workflow has at least one RunSnapshot in the journal at the end
Recovery with a snapshot is at least 10× faster than recovery without (per the benchmark evidence)
invariants: Snapshot integrity: snapshot.slots + tail_events == full journal replay (master §68.4 deterministic recovery)

happy: snapshot_written_after_n_steps: a 1000-step workflow produces at least 1 RunSnapshot in the journal at the end
recovery_uses_snapshot_when_available: a run with a snapshot recovers via hydrate_run_frame, not full replay
benchmark_snapshot_recovery_is_10x_faster: the benchmark (10_000 step workflow + recover) shows ≥10× speedup vs full replay
error: snapshot_with_commit_failure_aborts_run: a Fjall commit failure aborts the run with SnapshotCommitFailed
edge: snapshot_with_no_steps_does_not_write: a 0-step workflow does not write a RunSnapshot (the trigger is `N is a multiple of snapshot_interval_steps`)
snapshot_with_workflow_smaller_than_interval_writes_one_at_end: a 500-step workflow with interval 1000 writes exactly 1 RunSnapshot at the end

security_failures.failure: A snapshot is corrupted on disk, and recovery reads the corrupted data, leading to wrong state
security_failures.prevention: BLAKE3 + CRC32C envelope on every snapshot record; corrupt records are detected on read

usability_failures.failure: Operator can't tell whether snapshot recovery is enabled at runtime
usability_failures.prevention: vb status shows snapshot_interval_steps (depends on P1-11)

data_integrity_failures.failure: Snapshot and tail events diverge (e.g., tail events overwrite snapshot data with a different value)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: hydrate_run_frame applies tail events in strict order; divergence is a typed ReplayDiverged

integration_failures.failure: Benchmark shows no improvement, leaving the operator wondering if the feature is broken
integration_failures.prevention: Run the benchmark as part of this bead's evidence; commit the numbers
